meta.title: Weisiger Group · A trusted partner in your success
meta.description: Weisiger Group is the Charlotte-based, family-owned parent of Carolina Cat, Carolina Cat Power Systems, LiftOne and more, serving the Southeast since 1926.

hero.title: The family of companies that keep the Southeast
hero.body: For nearly 100 years, Weisiger Group has helped customers across five states succeed, with integrity, attention to detail and a promise kept every time.

carolinaCat.name: Carolina Cat
carolinaCat.body: Equipment sales, rental, product support and site technology that help customers finish projects safely, on time and on budget, across Western North Carolina.

rentals.name: Carolina Cat Rentals
rentals.title: Cat machines, aerial lifts, lift trucks and power generation

powerSystems.name: Carolina Cat Power Systems
powerSystems.body: Power generation, electrical controls and testing for facilities, venues and contractors, backed by parts, service and flexible rental from Cat and allied brands.

expanding.label: Now expanding

expanding.body: More sustainable power for facilities and venues

story.title: A family business since 1926
story.body: Formerly CTE, Weisiger Group has grown from one Carolinas dealership into a family of companies. Our reputation is earned through actions, commitment and dedication, every day.
story.yearCaption: the year our family started serving the Carolinas

community.title: Building our communities
community.body: From supplying equipment for critical infrastructure to giving and volunteering, we are invested in the future of our five-state region.

cares.title: Hurricane Helene relief

careers.title: Be part of something special
careers.body: We are more than a group of people working together. We are a family that supports, challenges and makes each other better.
